# Axiom01

> A semantic-first CSS framework for native HTML and CSS custom properties.

## Project guidance

- [Full framework specification](llms-full.txt)
- [Contributor and agent standards](AGENTS.md)
- [Framework overview and installation](README.md)
- [Build and maintenance workflow](docs/MAINTENANCE_WORKFLOW.md)

## Canonical sources

- Framework assets: `css/`, `js/`, `fonts/`, and `packages/`
- Documentation site: root `index.html`, `docs/`, `assets/`, `css/`, `js/`
- Release metadata: `release-info.json`

Generated `dist/` output is never edited or committed.
